## Vectary jobs: common questions

Is Vectary hiring right now?Vectary has no open roles listed as of November 9, 2026. Roles appear here as soon as they are posted on Vectary's careers site.

Where is Vectary headquartered?Vectary is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, United States and was founded in 2014.

Who leads Vectary?Michal Koor, CEO \| Co Founder, is at the top of Vectary's org chart.

How do I apply for a job at Vectary?Pick a role on Vectary's TheJobsMap page and select Apply. Every listing links to the original posting on Vectary's own careers site, so you apply directly with the employer.
